vikisozluk.baslik:
يرن (form I)
# يَرِنُّ (yarinnu) /ja.rin.nu/: third-person masculine singular non-past active indicative of رَنَّ (ranna)
# يُرَنُّ (yurannu) /ju.ran.nu/: third-person masculine singular non-past passive indicative of رَنَّ (ranna)
# يَرِنَّ (yarinna) /ja.rin.na/: third-person masculine singular non-past active subjunctive/jussive of رَنَّ (ranna)
# يُرَنَّ (yuranna) /ju.ran.na/: third-person masc

يرنان (form I)
# يَرِنَّانِ (yarinnāni) /ja.rin.naː.ni/: third-person masculine dual non-past active indicative of رَنَّ (ranna)
# يُرَنَّانِ (yurannāni) /ju.ran.naː.ni/: third-person masculine dual non-past passive indicative of رَنَّ (ranna)

يرنون (form I)
# يَرِنُّونَ (yarinnūna) /ja.rin.nuː.na/: third-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of رَنَّ (ranna)
# يُرَنُّونَ (yurannūna) /ju.ran.nuː.na/: third-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of رَنَّ (ranna)
